home.hero_p1: The time it takes for one cup of coffee is just enough to let the day slow down.

story.title: Our Story
story.subtitle: A cup of coffee, gently delivered to your hands
story.p1: Three Cups Coffee began with a single good cup. We select beans directly from their origins and craft the perfect roast and brew to share their aroma and warmth with every guest.
story.p2: We don’t chase flashiness; we seek clarity, balance, and the satisfaction of a well-finished cup. The aroma of a fine bean can evoke a mountain, and the steam from a pour-over can bring a moment of stillness.
story.p3: We believe great coffee doesn’t need to be complicated: choose the right beans, roast them cleanly, and brew them consistently. A simple daily cup is enough.
story.p4: Sipping a cup from us is a reminder: good things take patience, and so do our days.
story.pull_quote: Take your time with a cup of coffee—life gains its flavor.

vision.title: A Coffee That Walks With You
vision.subtitle: The quiet direction we strive toward.
vision.p1: We imagine a world where every bag of coffee beans carries the story of its origin, and every cup is unique because of the person brewing it. Some come from high-altitude mountain regions, others from origins shrouded in mist.
vision.p2: We are not chasing trends. We simply want to honestly hand you the details of origin, roast, and brewing, creating a visible connection between those who drink coffee and those who grow it.
vision.p3: We hope more people will slow down when grinding their beans and pause for a moment when pouring the hot water.
vision.p4: When you brew a cup of coffee and sit down to drink it slowly, the day slows down with you.

amber.title: Coffee Beans — From Origin to Cup
amber.subtitle: Every bag has its own unique flavor profile.
amber.p1: Coffee beans are a reflection of their origin. Altitude, climate, variety, and processing method all leave their mark in the cup. Ethiopian Yirgacheffe is renowned for its floral notes and citrus acidity, while Colombian Villa offers a smooth sweetness of caramel and red apple.
amber.p2: Coffee from Alishan, Taiwan, ripens slowly in the mist, carrying notes of tea and honey. We also offer our signature house blends, perfect for lattes and everyday drinking.
amber.p3: We select every bean with the same standard: clean flavor and consistent quality. Each bag includes details on origin, processing method, and roast date.

incense.title: Brewing Equipment — Brew a Better Cup
incense.subtitle: Stability is the key to consistent flavor.
incense.p1: Pour-over gear is simple: a dripper, filters, a gooseneck kettle, a grinder, and a digital scale. With these, you can brew excellent coffee at home.
incense.p2: The dripper controls water flow, the kettle ensures stable pouring, and the grinder guarantees uniform grounds. Starting with a V60 is the easiest choice.
incense.p3: Drippers, kettles, grinders, scales—different shapes, same goal: to let you consistently recreate every cup.

craft.title: The Patience of Hands
craft.p1: Our roasting begins with bean selection: we tailor the roasting curve to the characteristics of each lot, ensuring a clean and enjoyable cup.
craft.p2: Our goal is to preserve the origin's flavor, not mask it: light roasts retain brightness, while dark roasts bring out body.
craft.p3: Freshly roasted beans need time to rest and degas for stable flavor, so we recommend enjoying them within days to weeks of roasting.
craft.p4: Our blends pair beans from different regions: one provides a rich sweetness, the other a bright aroma. If the ratio is off, the flavor loses its depth.
craft.p5: We believe: slowness is a respect for nature.

about.title: Three Cups Coffee Studio
about.subtitle: One cup at a time, take it slow
about.p1: What remains in this corner is coffee, not people. Just beans, water, and a little time.
about.p2: Beans from the origin, time from our hands. From green bean to roast, from grind to pour, everything is slow.
about.p3: We believe great coffee comes from the details—bean selection, heat control, and patience. None can be missing.
about.p4: If you have thoughts on our materials, process, or pre-ordering, feel free to reach out and start a conversation.
about.faq_a1_a: Our writing style intentionally leaves space—slow words, slow sentences, slow paragraphs. Read at your own pace; no rushing, no clutter.
about.faq_q2_q: Why is it called Three Cups?
about.faq_a2_a: One cup to wake up, one to keep you company, one to relax. Three cups is the time we hope you reserve for yourself each day.
about.faq_a3_a: Great coffee comes from the details—bean selection, heat control, and patience. None can be missing.
about.faq_q4_q: How can I get in touch?
about.faq_a4_a: Reach out to us, and we will reply within one to two business days.
